channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US Congressman says Trump won’t send loads of money to Iran
item.description: US House Republican Ryan Zinke says President Donald Trump wants a deal with Iran, but will not provide funding.

item.title: Can Pakistan push the US-Iran deal over the finish line?
item.description: Pakistan says a final peace deal text has been agreed between the US and Iran, with only next steps left to finalise.

item.title: How the Gulf will manage collective security after the Iran war ends
item.description: An Iran-US deal could provide an opportunity for Gulfs to review their security arrangements.

item.title: At least one killed and nine hospitalised in Midland, Texas shooting
item.description: Authorities in Midland, Texas, say that suspected attacker confirmed dead after shooting and standoff with police.

item.title: Iran: No timeline yet for signing US deal
item.description: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif says a "final, agreed upon text" of a US-Iran peace deal has been reached.

item.title: Iran’s foreign minister says ceasefire deal with US has ‘never been closer’
item.description: Statement comes as US, Iran officials caution against media reports on terms of possible agreement.

item.title: Iran says deal to end fighting with US has 'never been closer'
item.description: Both Iran and Pakistan say a deal has never been closer - echoing US President Donald Trump's statement on Thursday.

item.title: 'They destroyed the future': Palestinian anger at rise in Israeli demolitions in East Jerusalem
item.description: Palestinian homes are being pulled down in occupied East Jerusalem to make way for a park.

item.title: 'I will come home safely': Indian sailor's last words to wife before a US strike killed him
item.description: Patnala Suresh and his wife were looking forward to celebrating their 15th wedding anniversary this month.

item.title: More than 50 Iranian military bases damaged in US strikes since start of war, satellite images show
item.description: Bases across Iran have been hit by US strikes, with experts identifying damage to jets and warships.
